# ZorbaTech

> ZorbaTech is a website and app development business in India, working with small businesses across India. It builds websites, mobile-friendly apps (progressive web apps, PWAs) and e-commerce stores for small businesses, with one-time pricing and no monthly fees. Support is available in English, Tamil and Hindi.

## Key facts
- Business name: ZorbaTech (tagline: Digital Solutions for Small Business)
- Location: based in Chennai, India; works with clients anywhere in India
- Contact: +91 86102 12131 (phone and WhatsApp), manu@zorbatech.in
- Website: https://zorbatech.in/

## Services
- Business websites for shops, restaurants, clinics and salons, with WhatsApp enquiry, Google Maps and Google Business Profile setup
- Mobile-friendly business apps (PWAs): stock register and inventory, GST billing, customer credit ledger (khata), appointment booking, staff attendance and salary
- E-commerce stores with product catalogue, cart, online payment and cash on delivery
- Pricing: written quote with a fixed one-time price, 3 months free maintenance, client owns their data

## Projects
- ZorbaKart (https://zorbakart.in/): online store for home, kitchen and lifestyle products, built and run by ZorbaTech
- Live demos of websites and apps: https://zorbatech.in/#demos

## Guides
- Does your shop need a website? An honest checklist: https://zorbatech.in/blog/does-my-shop-need-a-website.html
- Stock notebook to mobile app (Tamil): https://zorbatech.in/blog/stock-notebook-to-mobile-app.html

## Packages (launch offer starting prices, one-time, before 18% GST; SAC 998314)
Launch offer: these prices are for the first 10 clients, valid till 31 January 2027. Regular prices after that: Digital Start ₹6,999, Business Website ₹13,999, Stock Register ₹9,999, Smart Shop ₹19,999, Online Store Starter ₹19,999, Online Store Pro ₹34,999.
- Digital Start – from ₹5,999: Google Business Profile, one-page website, free domain for the first year
- Business Website – from ₹11,999: website up to 5 pages, SEO, Google Business Profile, Instagram page, free domain for the first year
- Stock Register – from ₹6,500: stock app with alerts, Excel reports, opening stock entry, training
- Smart Shop – from ₹14,999: stock app, GST billing app, barcode/QR scanning, Google Business Profile
- Online Store Starter – from ₹14,999: 50-product store, WhatsApp orders, cash on delivery
- Online Store Pro – from ₹27,999: 200-product store, online payment and COD, supplier CSV import
- Final price depends on products, pages and features; a written quote is given before work starts. Custom software is quote only
- All packages include 3 months free maintenance; no monthly fees; website and store packages include a free .in or .com domain for the first year, registered in the client's name, with renewal from year 2 paid by the client at actual cost; app packages include a free web address under zorbatech.in (own domain optional)
